title: Wall-Integrated Vestibule Correction + Universal 3D Right-Click Equipment Action
boundary: no transport routing/animation; ends at correctly positioned connection ports (Build 2 begins after)

defects_fixed.A: vestibule appeared as a freestanding rectangular mass in the cyclotron room instead of ATM-like wall-integrated interface
defects_fixed.B: right-click quick actions (esp. Delete) not universal across application-owned assets; vestibule had no right-click menu

defect_a_root_cause: seedWallIntegratedPose placed the pose center depth/2 INSIDE the room and oriented rear/ports toward the wall, so the whole port-bearing assembly floated in the room

defect_a_fix.wall_frame: WallFrame { origin, tangent, roomInwardNormal, wallOutwardNormal } with wallOutwardNormal = -roomInwardNormal; wallFrameForSide(footprint, wallSide)
defect_a_fix.pose: center = wallOrigin + wallOutwardNormal*(depth/2); front face flush with room-side wall plane; body extends behind wall; yaw from roomInwardNormal (not per-side guess)

collision_distinction.reservedVolumeFromPose: shallow room-side access slab (~0.35m into room) used for equipment collision
collision_distinction.fullOccupiedVolumeFromPose: full room-side + behind-wall AABB (reference + context pick)

defect_b_universal_right_click.governing_rule: if the user can see an application-owned object in 3D, they can right-click it

pick.pickVestibuleForContext: ray vs FULL occupied AABB; any visible component resolves the one vestibuleInstanceId

defect_b_universal_right_click.bim_protection: native wall/floor/ceiling/door/furniture never resolve to an application Delete target

honesty_note: On-screen wall integration, camera Fit, and live 3D/2D right-click are not headlessly verifiable; the wall-frame math, collision distinction, pick resolution, menu store, and delete convergence are test/typecheck/build verified.
